author: Lizardman529
body:
First, I don't know if this belongs in this thread, so please move it if it doesn't.

Anyway, a LOT of people like throwback. I'm maybe the biggest fan of it. Some maps just ruin avicus, and throwback has almost all of the good ones. I had an idea for an INSANE rotation, THROWBACK II: 

1: Quintus
2: Ternio
3: Rendezvous I
4: Rendezvous III (Rendezvous II is CTW)
5: Luar
6: Senex I
7: Senex II
8: Senex III
9: Rampage I (I believe, ask ProfessorUtonium)

I don't know who has the power to create a rotation, maybe a mapdev? Anyway, please tell me your thoughts :)

replies.body: -1. Because what you're saying is there is already a ThrowBack rotation and you want to add another one. The one is sufficient because there are only ever 2 servers open at a time. replies.body:
no pls. I don't want to start a rotation with a 1 hour match of Quintus :|
3 senex's in a row ;-; rip another 3 hour stalemate (1h each xd)
You gotta mix these rotations up to have it start nice and medium length game : 10-20 minutes and then you slip in the longer matches, not all of them at once and starting a rot with a long one like that.
